name: agentory-channels
description: Open-source IM channel adapters for Agentory — ChannelAdapter contract + official reference implementations + mock + contract test suite

scripts.build: npm run build -w @agentoryhq/im-channel-contract && npm run build -w @agentoryhq/im-channel-mock && npm run build -w @agentoryhq/im-channel-feishu && npm run build -w @agentoryhq/im-channel-dingtalk && npm run build -w @agentoryhq/im-channel-wecom && npm run build -w @agentoryhq/im-channel-wechat-personal
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/mock/dist/index.test.js packages/feishu/dist/index.test.js packages/dingtalk/dist/index.test.js packages/wecom/dist/index.test.js packages/wechat-personal/dist/index.test.js
